segments.ja321:1.1: Manussasseva te sīsaṃ, hatthapādā ca vānara;
segments.ja321:1.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, agāraṃ te na vijjati.
segments.ja321:2.1: Manussasseva me sīsaṃ, hatthapādā ca siṅgila [siṅgāla (ka.), piṅgala (ṭīkā)];
segments.ja321:2.3: Yāhu seṭṭhā manussesu, sā me paññā na vijjati.
segments.ja321:3.3: Niccaṃ addhuvasīlassa, sukhabhāvo [sucibhāvo (sī.), sukhabhāgo (?)] na vijjati.
